resources.string: No books yet.\n\nOn your computer, open a book in omareader, press E and export it as “omareader for Android”. Put the .omabook file in Google Drive or Dropbox, then add it here, or open it from there with omareader.
That file is not an omareader book. Export one from omareader on your computer as “omareader for Android”.
This book was exported by a newer omareader. Update the app to open it.
This book file is damaged or incomplete. Export it again.
The file could not be read, or the phone is out of space.
This book is no longer on the phone.
The book and its audio are deleted from this phone. The file you added it from stays where it is.
No book called “%1$s” on this phone.
The audio could not be played: %1$s
The book and its audio are deleted from this phone, and the book leaves your library on your other devices too. The file you added it from stays where it is.
This build of omareader has no Dropbox sync.
Waiting for Dropbox in the browser…
Books you export for the phone on your computer arrive here by themselves, and the place you reached follows you between the phone and the computer.

omareader keeps its files in Apps/omareader in your Dropbox and sees nothing else there. Your place in each book, the listening speed and the text size sync whenever you have a connection; new books download on Wi-Fi unless you allow mobile data.
This phone stops syncing. Your books stay on it, and the files in Dropbox stay where they are.
The last sync could not reach Dropbox. It will try again when the phone is online.
Dropbox no longer lets this phone in. Connect again to keep syncing.
Dropbox asked to wait before syncing again. It will try again shortly.
A book from Dropbox could not be added: it is damaged, or the phone is out of space.
omareader could not connect to Dropbox. Go back and try again.
